TOOLING BURST T1a-walk-2 — walk instrument METHOD CHANGE (SPEC § 6 row "T1a-walk-2"; conductor ruling R-26 after your honest FAILED on T1a-walk: the method was wrong — Otsu cannot separate a grey body from a grey grid, mask-top is not the head, and a planted foot on a fixed-camera plate is STATIONARY in image space). task_id "T1a-walk-2".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 6 rows "T1a-walk" and "T1a-walk-2" (the method-change row is your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md
3. astra_test_01/burst/oracle/{walk_landmarks.py, walk_curves.py, walk_bands.py, motion_map.py}, tests/test_oracle_walk.py, gates/common.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY.

IMPLEMENT the five numbered items by MODIFYING the T1a-walk modules in place (keep public functions; add the new ones; the old series stay under lineage names). Make the currently-red synthetic test green by the grid-registered median method, not by loosening the 2-px tolerance. Then RUN the four rows and report the numbers:
  (a) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05b Oracle - Muybridge plate 13 (woman walking)/_frames" --pattern 'lateral_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate13_lateral --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots   (PRIMARY)
  (b) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05b Oracle - Muybridge plate 13 (woman walking)/_frames" --pattern 'front_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate13_front --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots
  (c) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05b Oracle - Muybridge plate 13 (woman walking)/_frames" --pattern 'rear_*.png' --fps 8.33 --label plate13_rear --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots
  (d) --ref "/Users/admin/Desktop/Astra Burst Review - 2026-09-11/05 Oracle - Muybridge plate 2 (walk)/_frames" --pattern '[0-9][0-9].png' --fps 8.33 --label plate2_lateral --out oracle/bands_walk.json --plot_dir runs/C-1/oracle/plots   (secondary; dark on dark)
Write a mask_check plot per row showing frame 1 AND frame 7 masks, the tracked head box, the two sole points and the planted flags, so the conductor can verify by eye. Muybridge is public domain; plots under runs/C-1/oracle/plots/ are fine.
Then run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected all green except the four named T0-d3 reds; report exact counts.

DO NOT touch: lane/, oracles/, parts/, transcribe/, compare/, bible/, gates/ (read only), the idle modules (read only), SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, briefs/, fixtures/. Under runs/ write ONLY runs/C-1/oracle/. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under tests/tmp/.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T1a-walk-2"): files = every created/modified file with sha256; images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name precisely anything not met, with numbers, AND per row: mask area/H range, grid_leak, contact frames found, W-1 (tracked head) %H with the 1–5 % sanity flag, W-2 phases of min/max, W-3a/c, W-4, W-5 per side, W-6, swing-foot scroll px/frame, the 12-frame phase table. Never PASS/FAIL.
